rationales: Momentum is not the contact force that lets a runner push against the ground.

Acceleration describes a change in velocity, not the force at the foot-ground contact.
Friction lets the runner push the ground backward and receive a forward force.

Nm⁻² is not the SI unit of torque.

Kinetic energy is the energy a body has due to its motion.
Power is the rate of doing work, not the energy of motion.
Velocity is a measure of motion, not the work or energy due to motion.

a is acceleration, not the rate of change of momentum itself.
